metadata.description: Eight Claude Code mods from the RoboNuggets 9 Mods guide, vendored with their original licenses. The ninth, You Should Know, is built in.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Agents panel and progress bar: every subagent, its model, progress and estimated cost. /agents-info.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Restyle tool rows, diffs and tables with themes. /skin <name>.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: File tree pane that lights up the files Claude touches. Use /tui fullscreen.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Holds a send once when the prompt cache is cold and shows the cost. /keepwarm.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change.

plugins.name: reflect-mod
plugins.description: Turns your corrections into saved CLAUDE.md rules.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A real browser pane in the terminal. Needs the terminal-browser binary. Mac and Linux.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay steps through every file edit Claude made, one diff at a time.
